messages:
erin: FYI PR #4321 landed a tweak to the console examples where we renamed the kv-prefetch preset field from `prefetchWindow` -> `prefetch_window_ms`. Quickstart preview now shows failing Node/Python snippets. CI caught it :grimace:

josh: ugh i saw that — the snippet generator pulls keys by name. i can push a tiny shim to the snippet build to accept both names for the short term. want me to?

vivian: +1 on shim. we still need a docs migration note though. The change is breaking for anyone who copied presets verbatim.

alex: tagging @josh please. also need to think about the release side — this is in the console rollout canary. if we do a docs-only shim we can avoid a full rollback.

josh: i'll open a patch PR for the snippet generator in ~15m. patch will: 1) accept both keys in the example parser, 2) leave a TODO to remove acceptance after 2 releases, 3) update generated snippets to prefer `prefetch_window_ms`.

deploy-bot: CI failure on docs/examples/generator — snippet-compat-test.py failed (exit code 1). see https://ci.redwood/inference/4321/build/5

erin: thanks. can someone add a short migration blurb under Console -> Observability -> KV Prefetching examples? should say old key->new key and a copy/paste replacement snippet. also add a redirect from the old example anchor if possible.

vivian: i'll draft the migration paragraph and the copy/paste YAML. can we standardize the units in the message? ms vs seconds has tripped people before.

alex: make it explicit: "value in milliseconds (integer)". add an example showing the conversion.

vivian: draft below, PTAL:

```
# old preset (deprecated)
kv_prefetch:
  prefetchWindow: 1500

# new preset
kv_prefetch:
  prefetch_window_ms: 1500
```

vivian: i'll put that in a short migration note section and link to the SDK snippets that need update: examples/node/kv_prefetch.js, examples/python/kv_prefetch.py, examples/go/kv_prefetch.go

erin: perfect. once josh's generator shim is up we can merge the docs PR and re-run snippet generation, then unshard the canary. if anyone wants to claim the PR reviews i can do docs review, alex can do ops review.

josh: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987 — includes generator shim + updated generated snippets + TODO deprecation comment. CI is rerunning.

deploy-bot: docs PR 987 — snippet-compat test passed. generation job green.

alex: looks good. schedule: merge docs PR, monitor playground-preview for 1 hour on canary, then promote. if any regressions flag rollback.

erin: assigning ownership: erin -> docs PR merge + migration note; josh -> generator revert plan (remove shim after 2 releases); vivian -> update examples in language folders and add redirect; alex -> monitor canary and ops rollback path. :thumbsup:
